command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-matched-v2.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SCRIPT="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/validate_matched_eye_ab.py"
TEST="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/test_validate_matched_eye_ab_ordering.py"
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_matched_frozen_ab_v2_20260912_0906"
test -f "$SCRIPT"; test -f "$TEST"; test -f "$SHADOW"; test ! -e "$OUT"
python3 "$TEST"
BRANCH_HEAD=$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD)
echo BRANCH_HEAD=$BRANCH_HEAD
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$SCRIPT" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9264 --cdp-port 9265 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_matched_frozen_ab_v2_20260912_0906.stdout.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
cat "$OUT/report.json"
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_MATCHED_VIRTUAL_TIME_FROZEN_CANONICAL_EYE_AB_V2_NO_LIVE_WRITE
